caption: popcap's molecule puzzle - slide atoms into four-square reactions before the grid chokes.
about: Atomica deluxe builds reactions under pressure: colored atoms fall onto a grid and you push them around one square at a time, grouping four of a kind to detonate a molecule. Black atoms clog the board, bombs tick on timers, and the grid slowly tightens until the chemistry stops cooperating. It is the purest traffic-jam puzzle popcap shipped, and one of the quietest.

The deluxe pc build never reached the current stores - popcap retired the pre-merger catalog and atomica went with it, so this page keeps the archive route. The reaction rules survive intact in every copy: plan the whole grid or the grid plans you.
